title: Founder
signal: Welcome flow opens with the hydroxytyrosol science and pushes the CTA below three paragraphs of body copy.

variants.subject: your welcome email
variants.body:
Sarah — signed up to Olivea's list to see the flow.

The hydroxytyrosol explainer is genuinely good, but it runs three paragraphs before the buy button shows up. That's usually where first-purchase conversion leaks: people who were already sold have to work to find the CTA.

We rebuild flows like this for olive-oil and supplement brands — same story, restructured so the CTA sits with the hook.

Worth a quick look at what I'd change?

variants.subject: the reorder window you're not texting
variants.body:
Sarah — went through Olivea's signup path and there's no SMS anywhere in it.

For a consumable like olive oil the reorder window is predictable to within a couple of weeks. That's the highest-margin SMS trigger a brand like yours has, and right now it isn't running at all — the whole repeat-purchase nudge is riding on email.

I'd sketch what that sequence looks like for your reorder cycle. Worth 15 minutes?

variants.subject: same copy, different order
variants.body:
Sarah — quick one about Olivea's welcome flow.

We took a wellness brand with the same setup you have — strong science up front, buy button three paragraphs down — and just restructured it: hook, benefit, CTA, then the deep explainer for people who want it. Same words, different order.

I can show you that before and after next to your current flow if it's useful.
